ours-precision.short: Night School's precision measurements, computed for this film
ours-precision.citation: media/school/precision/facts.json, written by tools/school/fill_precision.mjs from system/school/precision*.mjs: exact fp16 and bf16 rounding checked on every bit pattern; spacing and error by magnitude; long sums; the attention model's layers and the whole model run with 16-bit storage and 32-bit or 16-bit accumulation, scored on 1,024 held-out rows with paired intervals.
claims: Near 110: fp16 spacing 0.0625, worst rounding 0.03125; 13 significand bits needed for 1e-4, fp16 has 11.
Adding 1 stalls at 2,048 in fp16 and 256 in bf16.
Whole-model loss changes under 1e-3 nats in every 16-bit mode.
ours-precision.does_not_prove: Anything about large models trained in 16 bits.

ieee754.citation: IEEE (2019). IEEE Standard for Floating-Point Arithmetic, IEEE 754-2019 (binary16 parameters, checked against ISO/IEC TS 18661-3).
ieee754.read: parameters checked against ISO/IEC TS 18661-3; the standard itself is paywalled and was not read

micikevicius2018.short: Micikevicius and others 2018, Mixed Precision Training
micikevicius2018.citation: Micikevicius, P., Narang, S., Alben, J., and others (2018). Mixed Precision Training. ICLR 2018. arXiv:1710.03740.
claims: Train in fp16 with an fp32 master copy of weights, loss scaling, and fp32 accumulation of products.

nvidia.short: NVIDIA CUDA Programming Guide, tensor core element types
nvidia.citation: NVIDIA (2026). CUDA Programming Guide 13.4.2, section 5.4.11.6, Element Types and Matrix Sizes.
claims: Tensor core operations take fp16 inputs with fp16 or fp32 accumulators, and bf16 inputs with fp32 accumulators.

rawnative.short: raw-native evidence note on the denoiser's tensor-core parity, 15 October 2026
claims: A value near 110 needs about 1e-4 relative precision; fp16 holds about 1e-3 there (order of magnitude).
rawnative.does_not_prove: Anything about this film's arithmetic beyond the stated figures.
